# Echelon Facilitation

> Echelon Facilitation is an independent UK facilitation practice, based in Twickenham, that designs and runs high-stakes sessions for leadership teams: strategy offsites, executive alignment workshops and AI strategy workshops that end in written decisions, named owners and a 30-day follow-up, not more discussion.

Echelon Facilitation is a trading name of Dr Andrew Greenland (sole trader), Twickenham, UK. It was founded by Dr Andrew Greenland, a medical doctor (emergency medicine background) and educator. As Head of Assessment at a leading UK medical school he designs and facilitates large, high-stakes working sessions - around 18 a year, with up to 70-90 clinicians, academics and professional actors - that create, test and agree final exams. He is trained in design sprint and workshop methods and is a verified facilitator on facilitator.com. Echelon is a new practice: Andrew designs and leads every engagement, working with trusted associate facilitators for groups of more than 15. It works with leadership teams in the UK and internationally, in person and virtually.

## Services and prices

All prices are for the whole team and exclude VAT. Each includes a diagnostic call, participant pre-work, session design, facilitation, a written decision log and a 30-day follow-up call. Founding client rates (around 30% lower) are available to the first three clients in return for an approved, anonymised case study.

- [Half-day session](https://www.echelonfacilitation.com/pricing.html): Decision-Rights Reset and conflict or deadlock sessions. £2,500-£3,500.
- [Full-day session](https://www.echelonfacilitation.com/workshops.html): Executive Alignment Sprint, Strategy Sprint, Transformation Alignment Workshop. £4,500-£6,000.
- [AI Design Sprint](https://www.echelonfacilitation.com/ai-design-sprint.html): one or two days; a prioritised, governed AI roadmap with named owners for an executive team. £6,000-£9,000.
- [Strategy & Vision Offsite](https://www.echelonfacilitation.com/workshops.html#strategy): 1.5-2 days for annual planning or a strategic reset. £7,500-£10,000.
- [Design Sprint](https://www.echelonfacilitation.com/design-sprint.html): 3-5 days, 5-8 people; takes a new product, service or process from idea to a prototype tested with real users. £10,000-£16,000.
- [Add-ons](https://www.echelonfacilitation.com/how-we-work.html): 90-day review session (£1,250), execution cadence design (£1,500), quarterly review retainer (£4,500 a year).

## Not offered

1:1 or executive coaching, facilitation training, retained strategy consulting, HR or legal advice, recruitment, keynotes, team-building events, psychometric assessments, courses, software and mediation.
